test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question:
**Direction: **Study the following information carefully to answer the questions given below-

Six friends A, E, H, R, V and N are sitting around the circular table facing outside the center not necessarily in the same order. N sits second to the left of R. E sits immediate right of A. Two persons are sitting between E and V.

Who sits third left of H?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) E sits immediate right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/931c49ac774ba5ab302929721f0cb1dd95e7ef48c80cd31e56b4ff3434b24f24.png] 

2) Two persons are sitting between E and V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0e175282d7ff9dabf8ea06e57a77f7027164798ebd2f823321ec995ffe2ebb3.png] 

3) N sits second to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dec75d69ccf287a2fb46fafeb9a16ee0f5456d7b2bdb5062d3294bbf414cf911.png] 

Hence, R sits third left of H.
